Local browser dependencies for the workflow animation:
- HyperFrames player 0.9.8, standalone global bundle; @hyperframes/player on jsDelivr.
- HyperFrames core runtime 0.9.8; @hyperframes/core on jsDelivr. Apache 2.0, see HYPERFRAMES-LICENSE.
- GSAP 3.14.2, dist/gsap.min.js from npm via jsDelivr. Original copyright/license header retained; license: https://gsap.com/standard-license/.
- Manrope regular and medium, Google Fonts v23. SIL Open Font License, see MANROPE-LICENSE.
The animation is authored in ../workflow.html with a finite paused GSAP timeline registered for HyperFrames. No remote runtime dependencies are needed for this asset.
